name: call-notes
description: Turn project-relevant business call recordings into transcripts, summaries, and follow-up notes.

interface.shortDescription: Turn relevant calls into project notes.
interface.longDescription: Matches provider call records against a project root PEOPLE.md dossier, downloads relevant call recordings, transcribes audio with OpenAI, and writes transcript and summary markdown files under the project root.
defaultPrompt: Transcribe the latest call for this project.
Set up this project for call notes automation.
Find relevant calls from PEOPLE.md and write call notes.
